294:t_10:29.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Then, back to what we were discussing...」

294:t_10:30.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Hey, what's the other world's $$万丈$$ like? Of course I was the one beside him, right?」

294:t_10:31.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you talking about, $$レイカ$$!? It had to be me!」

294:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Understood. If you're going to argue that much, I'll tell you a little story I know.」

294:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that world, $$万丈$$ is a private detective in a floating city on $$東京湾$$.」

294:t_10:37.en:
$$レイカ$$
「A private detective... Then his partner must be me, an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ prep-school student.」

294:t_10:39.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...This could take a while, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

294:t_10:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「Indeed. Then let's do that thing ourselves.」

294:t_10:41.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Now you're talking! ...Let's give it our all today too!」

294:t_10:43.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...You really put your heart into it, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

294:t_10:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm particular about my catchphrases too.」

295:t_000:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「The $$ＺＯＮＥ$$... This thing sure put us through a lot.」

295:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But when we repaired space-time at $$アクシズ$$, the ones on Earth were a big help.」

295:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「It all depends how we use it. Both this $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ and our own power.」

295:t_000:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$'s been acting a little cool lately... Don't you think so, $$ワッ太$$?」

295:t_000:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「He's a colonel, not a captain! Remember it already, $$勝平$$!」

295:t_000:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Oh, it's no use, $$クェス$$. $$勝平$$ isn't the type to learn just by being told.」

295:t_000:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「It seems you had the same thought as me, $$マリーダ$$.」

295:t_000:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Yes, Colonel. I think $$クェス$$ and $$勝平$$ are alike in their childlike nature, in a good way.」

295:t_000:9.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're both so mean! Colonel, $$マリーダ$$!」

295:t_000:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「What are you saying, Sis $$クェス$$!? Does being like me bother you that much!?」

295:t_000:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「People call you a child because you pick a fight so quickly.」

295:t_000:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's investigate the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ now. We don't have time to play around.」

295:t_000:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... He's so calm and collected. Can changing your hairstyle really change you that much?」

295:t_000:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's what being an adult is like.」

295:t_000:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Someday you'll understand the colonel too, $$勝平$$.」

295:t_000:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah, yeah. I'm just a brat, so there!」

295:t_000:19.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ are younger than you, but they know what they need to do.」

295:t_000:20.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then what about Big Bro $n, going out on his own?」

295:t_000:22.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n is $n, and he seems to have his own thoughts on this.」

295:t_000:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「How about it, $n? Do you sense anything?」

295:t_000:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Lately, I haven't felt uneasy as often as I used to.」

295:t_000:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because you've helped me become more positive, $n...」

295:t_000:29.en:
$$アルト$$
(Lately, I can't tell which is the guardian, $n or Miss $$スズネ$$...)

295:t_000:30.en:
$$甲児$$
(Yeah... It seems Miss $$スズネ$$ is relying on $n.)

295:t_000:31.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Are you lonely because a fellow $$ボランティア部$$ member grew up before you?)

295:t_000:34.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you two brats just like $$勝平$$!? Stop playing and get to work!」

295:t_001:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So they're here to welcome us as we approach the Earth sphere?」

295:t_001:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Or they intend to use $$火星$$'s $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ to extract $$次元力$$.」

295:t_001:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We have no need to use such a thing.」

295:t_001:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「There she is, the cool beauty!」

295:t_001:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「That sounds like a compliment, $$ノノ$$!」

295:t_001:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「First, I sincerely commend your return alive to the Earth sphere. Your attachment to life is stronger than I imagined.」

295:t_001:7.en:
$$グラハム$$
「We didn't go through hell for nothing.」

295:t_001:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「If that lady's here, $$尸空#pilot$$ must be nearby too...!」

295:t_001:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...Very well. Although this isn't merely a side task, I will deal with you.」

295:t_001:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I needn't answer. It's a trivial matter that doesn't concern you.」

295:t_001:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...! She's as emotionless as her captain!」

295:t_001:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I won't show mercy just because you're a woman if you're part of $$サイデリアル$$!」

295:t_001:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「If you can stir my heart or $$尸空#pilot$$'s, that would be cause for joy.」

295:t_001:20.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...It seems I've said too much. Let us begin.」

295:t_001:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, deploy! We'll intercept $$サイデリアル$$!」

295:t_001:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come, crab lady! I'll beat you and drag out that bastard $$尸空#pilot$$!」
